title: Irrigation and nitrogen together
intro: Water moves nitrate and decides how much of the fertiliser the crop can use. Irrigation against rainfed, at three fertiliser doses, shows whether more water raises the yield only when the nitrogen is there, and what it costs in nitrate below the roots.
